On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题post-training / alignment data
Byeongho Heo, Jaehui Hwang, Sangdoo Yun, Dongyoon Han
high · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 这项工作为多语言数学推理后训练提供了强化学习之外的蒸馏路线：用教师模型与基础模型之间的概率差作为学习信号，在韩语和日语上尤其有效，并通常缩小英语与韩语之间的性能差距。结果还提醒研究者，单语英语训练虽可能迁移到其他语言，却会把回答推向英语，因此目标语言数据仍是保持语言一致性的关键。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 24）
方法解读
01
问题

多语言数学推理中，在策略蒸馏的有效性及其对目标语言保持能力尚不清楚。

02
方法

该方法用后训练教师模型与基础模型的输出概率差来指导在策略蒸馏。

03
差异

相比原始在策略蒸馏，它把教师相对基础模型新增的概率信息作为学习信号，并直接考察英语、韩语和日语。

04
证据

通义千问第三代模型实验显示该方法持续优于原始方法，且在韩语和日语上提升更强。

摘要

在策略蒸馏正成为大语言模型后训练中强化学习的替代方案，但其多语言效果仍缺乏研究。本文研究了在英语、韩语和日语数学推理上的在策略蒸馏及其增量变体：后者使用后训练教师模型与基础模型之间的概率差作为学习信号。基于通义千问第三代模型的实验表明，该变体持续优于原始方法，在韩语和日语上的提升尤其明显，并通常缩小英语与韩语之间的性能差距；同时，纯英语训练也能提升韩语和日语性能，但常使回答转向英语，说明多语言数据对于保持目标语言回答十分重要。

为什么值得看 这项工作把多模态平衡从一个被忽视的问题转化为自蒸馏中的特权信号：通过正向教师、负向教师及模态平衡信任区域筛选在策略令牌，视觉推理后训练不再只依赖额外输入信息。论文称该方法在六个基准、四个多模态模型骨干和五种后训练方法上持续提升推理表现，同时降低训练成本，适合关注多模态推理效率的研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 9）
方法解读
01
问题

视觉在策略自蒸馏中的特权信息设计忽视了文本主导生成造成的模态失衡。

02
方法

方法用放大图像和遮挡图像分别构造正向教师与负向教师，并利用概率间隔建立模态平衡信任区域来筛选令牌。

03
差异

它不只从多样输入中提取教师信号，而是直接把不同模态平衡程度编码为自蒸馏监督。

04
证据

在六个基准、四个模型骨干和五种后训练方法上的实验显示推理性能持续提升且训练成本降低。

摘要

现有的在策略自蒸馏方法利用多种输入来源提供特权信息，但忽视了多模态大语言模型推理中的模态失衡：当文本主导生成时，模型难以充分整合多模态输入。本文使用放大图像构造正向教师、使用遮挡图像构造负向教师，并从推理正确性和令牌概率变化中发现，模态平衡本身可以作为特权信息；据此提出一种视觉在策略自蒸馏方法，用正向教师和负向教师实现该信息，并以正向模态平衡概率间隔定义模态平衡信任区域，选择用于自蒸馏的在策略令牌。实验覆盖六个基准、四个多模态模型骨干和五种后训练方法，结果显示该方法持续提升推理性能并降低训练成本。

为什么值得看 这项工作把计算机使用代理的记忆从语言摘要推进到可复现的行为记录：无需模型即可将屏幕活动压缩为可审计、可缓存的上下文，并让已识别的例行操作在命中时零模型令牌重放。对关注代理成本、记忆可靠性和工作流自动化的研究者，它还提供了例行开销比与重复率这两个用于估算可委托任务规模的量化接口；不过证据主要来自单个专业用户的数据集。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 18）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

代理记忆缺少用户实际执行的屏幕行为，导致代理重复推理已经完成的例行任务。

02
方法

流水线将本地屏幕采集流分段为带应用、网站、时间、输入量和原始证据指针的活动帧。

03
差异

编译过程不使用模型，因此输出逐字节一致、可缓存、可审计，并能在匹配时脱离模型重放。

04
证据

在五十一天、十二万八千七百五十六帧的单用户数据上，压缩比例为八十六倍、耗时六十八毫秒，问答准确率为百分之九十八点四。

摘要

计算机使用代理通常需要再次进行前沿模型推理，以重新发现用户已经执行过的例行操作，因为现有记忆记录的是用户说了什么，而不是用户做了什么。本文使用确定性的零模型流水线，将被动采集的屏幕活动切分为带类型的活动帧和有界事件段，记录应用、网站、时间、输入量以及指向原始数据行的证据指针；在一名专业用户的单用户数据集上，它将一天的原始记录压缩为小八十六倍的可直接放入提示词的上下文，并在六十八毫秒内完成，使代理以百分之九十八点四的准确率回答当天活动问题，而同一数据的语言模型摘要仅达到百分之六十六至百分之八十。该编译器还可用于估算例行开销比和例行重复率，报告的样本内可委托重复率为百分之九点零、样本外为百分之七点七，并展示了在守护条件匹配时无需模型令牌即可确定性重放例行操作。

为什么值得看 这项工作把教师与学生在同一任务上的可执行差异转化为可验证、可维护的技能补丁，适合在冻结学生模型上持续改进代理能力；它还用带轨迹的编辑历史抑制局部更新造成的技能漂移。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 10）
方法解读
01
问题

学生代理的失败轨迹可能缺少任务知识或操作策略，教师轨迹也可能过于隐含，导致技能难以直接复用。

02
方法

方法比较同一任务上的学生失败与教师轨迹，生成文本技能补丁，并通过重新运行学生和带轨迹的技能整合反复修订补丁。

03
差异

它不把技能仅作为经验摘要或记忆条目，而是显式编码跨能力代理之间的可执行差异，并管理补丁对既有规则的增删改。

04
证据

在五个代理基准和两种学生设置中，方法据称持续优于固定模型适应基线。

摘要

技能提示已经成为提升大语言模型代理的实用机制，但现有技能获取方法通常把技能当作经验摘要、记忆条目或成功示范的直接总结，这使能力较弱的学生代理难以从自身失败轨迹中推断缺失行为，也难以内化教师轨迹中隐含的策略。该方法利用同一任务上的学生失败和教师轨迹，将可执行差异蒸馏为文本技能补丁，通过重新运行学生评估并迭代修补；同时维护与轨迹关联的编辑历史，判断补丁应新增、删除、修改既有规则还是跳过，以减少技能漂移。在五个代理基准和两种学生设置中，该方法持续提升了冻结学生代理的表现，优于固定模型适应基线。

为什么值得看 这项工作把三维场景多模态推理从固定输入组合改为按查询动态选择模态，可能同时减少无关语义噪声与计算浪费，并让视觉线索和几何线索在不同语义任务中发挥更合适的作用。对于研究三维多模态大模型、具身感知和自适应推理的读者，重点应看其路由信号、专家激活机制以及模态选择带来的实际收益。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 18）
方法解读
01
问题

固定模态组合会把不相关的视觉或几何信息带入查询推理，并造成计算浪费。

02
方法

智能法师用语义先验、文本模态对齐和模态质量进行自适应路由，并用模态先验控制专家激活。

03
差异

它同时在输入模态选择和专家分工两个层面实现查询相关的多模态适配，而不是对所有查询使用同一组合。

04
证据

论文报告其在五个三维场景理解基准上取得领先表现，并在扫描面板诊断基准中观察到与语义类别对应的模态偏好模式。

摘要

三维场景理解需要联合处理视觉和几何等异构信息，但不同查询对模态的需求并不相同；现有多模态大语言模型通常固定组合模态，可能引入无关信息、削弱推理并浪费计算。本文提出智能法师，一种面向语义感知三维场景理解的统一多模态大语言模型，通过语义引导的模态自适应路由模块选择相关模态，并通过模态感知门控专家模块引导专家激活和多模态推理的自适应专门化；实验表明，该方法在五个三维场景理解基准上取得领先表现，在仅使用彩色视频的视频理解基准上也达到有竞争力的结果，扫描面板诊断基准进一步显示了不同语义类别偏好的模态组合。

为什么值得看 该方法把跨机器人迁移拆成共享动力学表征与具身专属控制两部分：用未来预测学习物体运动、接触和交互后的场景变化，再由混合专家动作头直接输出各机器人原生动作，从而避免手工对齐异构动作空间；这对需要一个策略覆盖多种机器人形态的研究者尤其有价值。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 18）
方法解读
01
问题

异构机器人共享一个通用操作策略时，现有方法既没有充分利用跨具身数据中的动力学先验，也依赖手工动作预处理。

02
方法

模型用未来预测目标训练共享查询表示，并用共享注意力层和具身专属前馈专家组成动作头。

03
差异

动作头在每个具身的原生动作空间中直接生成控制，同时分别处理共同的时间结构和不同的运动学约束。

04
证据

论文报告自由宝库成功率为百分之九十八、机器人之家抓取任务为百分之五十九点二五、双胞胎二点零为百分之八十九点零二。

摘要

视觉语言动作模型已成为机器人操作的重要范式，但为异构机器人训练单一通用策略仍然困难。该方法通过跨具身未来预测学习共享动力学先验，并使用具身专属的混合专家动作头将先验直接转换为各机器人原生控制信号，无需手工预对齐动作；论文报告其在模拟和真实世界评测中取得较高成功率，在自由宝库上为百分之九十八，在机器人之家抓取任务上为百分之五十九点二五，在双胞胎二点零上为百分之八十九点零二。

为什么值得看 这项工作把大语言模型的数值推理放到最长三万二千个词元的完整财务报表上检验，而不是裁剪表格或选择题；结果显示，去掉公式提示后，某模型在表格任务上的准确率从百分之七十点七降至百分之三十八点二二，说明时间反累加、存量与流量口径不匹配以及多期多指标组织仍会击穿表面化推理，并表明结构化监督微调能带来部分恢复。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 14）
方法解读
01
问题

现有金融推理基准主要使用选择题、单跳问答和裁剪表格，无法覆盖跨报表动态与时间反累加。

02
方法

基准通过自动合成带对抗性陷阱的完整财务报表，测试单指标计算和表格指标汇总。

03
差异

评测同时施加长上下文、多指标多期间组织、时间处理和存量流量口径匹配压力，并比较有无公式提示的表现。

04
证据

去除公式提示后，某模型的表格任务表现由百分之七十点七降至百分之三十八点二二，监督微调带来单指标百分之八点五四和表格百分之三点八二的零提示提升。

摘要

大语言模型是否具备真正的结构化推理能力，还是仅依赖表面模式匹配，仍缺乏现实检验。本文提出金融指标基准，在最长三万二千个词元的完整财务报表上，通过带有对抗性陷阱的自动合成流程，评估单指标计算和表格指标汇总中的领域、时间与口径推理；结果发现模型存在知识瓶颈和结构瓶颈，而监督微调可部分恢复结构化逻辑。

为什么值得看 这项工作给低资源语言的检索增强生成提供了完整适配路径：在专业希腊语语料上，经过领域训练的嵌入模型将前十位归一化折损累计增益从百分之三十六点二提升到百分之八十三点五，三十亿参数混合专家阅读器的答案正确率也从百分之二十九点四升至百分之六十六点九。它还表明，通用多语稠密检索并不一定胜过无需训练的概率检索，效果取决于语言和领域适配；需要处理希腊语或其他低资源语言检索增强生成的研究者应重点关注其数据构造、重排器和生成器联合适配方法。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 24）
方法解读
01
问题

现代希腊语缺少专业领域检索语料、检索模型支持和大规模检索增强生成评测基准。

02
方法

作者挖掘语料并生成监督数据，训练嵌入检索器，适配交叉编码器重排器，再对混合专家阅读器进行低秩微调。

03
差异

该流程同时覆盖检索、重排和有依据生成，并以希腊语专业领域数据替代直接使用未适配的多语模型。

04
证据

六万五千七百七十三个检索对使嵌入模型的前十位归一化折损累计增益达到百分之八十三点五，阅读器答案正确率达到百分之六十六点九，并提出赫拉基准。

摘要

问题

计算机使用代理通常需要再次进行前沿模型推理，以重新发现用户已经执行过的例行操作，因为现有记忆记录的是用户说了什么，而不是用户做了什么。本文使用确定性的零模型流水线，将被动采集的屏幕活动切分为带类型的活动帧和有界事件段，记录应用、网站、时间、输入量以及指向原始数据行的证据指针；在一名专业用户的单用户数据集上，它将一天的原始记录压缩为小八十六倍的可直接放入提示词的上下文，并在六十八毫秒内完成，使代理以百分之九十八点四的准确率回答当天活动问题，而同一数据的语言模型摘要仅达到百分之六十六至百分之八十。该编译器还可用于估算例行开销比和例行重复率，报告的样本内可委托重复率为百分之九点零、样本外为百分之七点七，并展示了在守护条件匹配时无需模型令牌即可确定性重放例行操作。

On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicpost-training / alignment data
Byeongho Heo, Jaehui Hwang, Sangdoo Yun, Dongyoon Han
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters This paper gives multilingual mathematical-reasoning post-training an alternative to reinforcement learning: it uses the teacher-versus-base probability gap as the distillation signal, with especially strong gains in Korean and Japanese and generally smaller English–Korean gaps. It also shows that English-only training can transfer across languages while pushing outputs toward English, so target-language data remains important for preserving response language.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 24)
Method brief
01
Problem

The effectiveness of on-policy distillation and its ability to preserve target languages are unclear for multilingual mathematical reasoning.

02
Method

The method trains on the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model.

03
Difference

Compared with original on-policy distillation, it uses teacher-added probability information as the learning signal and evaluates English, Korean, and Japanese directly.

04
Evidence

Experiments with Qwen3 report consistent gains over original on-policy distillation, with stronger improvements in Korean and Japanese.

Abstract

On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We study OPD and its advanced variant, On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD^2), for mathematical reasoning in English, Korean, and Japanese. OPD^2 improves OPD by using the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model as the learning signal. Experiments with Qwen3 show that OPD^2 consistently outperforms the original OPD, with particularly strong improvements in Korean and Japanese, and generally narrows the English-Korean performance gap. We further find that English-only OPD can also increase performance for Korean and Japanese, but often shifts the responses toward English, highlighting the importance of multilingual data to preserving target-language responses.

OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicpost-training / alignment data
Aniri, Jinhe Bi, Peng Liao, Zengjie Jin, Volker Tresp, Fei Shen et al.
high · 2026-08-05

Why it matters This work turns modality balance into a usable privileged signal for multimodal self-distillation: positive and negative visual teachers define a trust region that filters on-policy tokens instead of relying only on extra input sources. The paper reports consistent reasoning gains with lower training cost across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods, making it relevant to researchers optimizing visual reasoning post-training.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 9)
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing on-policy self-distillation designs overlook modality imbalance when text dominates the generated reasoning.

02
Method

The method uses a zoom-in image and a mask image as positive and negative teachers, then selects tokens through a modality-balance trust region defined by logit margins.

03
Difference

Rather than treating privileged information as coming mainly from diverse inputs, it encodes the degree of modality balance directly into the distillation signal.

04
Evidence

Experiments on 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods report consistent reasoning improvements and reduced training cost.

Abstract

On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. When textual information dominates generation, the model cannot fully integrate its multimodal input. Consequently, carefully designed privileged information remains underused, limiting the effectiveness of OPSD. To examine this limitation, we construct a Positive Teacher with the Zoom-In Image and a Negative Teacher with the Mask Image, which exhibit different degrees of Modality Imbalance. Changes in their reasoning correctness and token logits reveal that Modality Balance can itself serve as privileged information. Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation. Experiments across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods show that OPD-V consistently improves reasoning performance while reducing training cost.

Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Nossa Iyamu
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters This work turns computer-use memory from language summaries into reproducible behavior records: a zero-model compiler produces auditable, cacheable context and can replay matched routines with zero model tokens. For researchers studying agent cost, memory reliability, and workflow automation, it also exposes measurable routine overhead and recurrence parameters; the main caveat is that the evidence comes from one professional user's corpus.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 18)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Agent memory records what users said rather than the screen actions needed to recover already performed routines.

02
Method

A deterministic pipeline segments local screen captures into typed activity frames with application, site, timing, input-volume, and raw-evidence pointers.

03
Difference

Unlike model-generated summaries, the compiler is model-free, byte-identical, cacheable, auditable, and able to replay matched routines without model inference.

04
Evidence

Abstract

Computer-use agents pay full frontier inference to re-derive routines their user has already performed, because an agent's memory today records what the user said, not what the user did. We compile passively captured screen activity into agent memory with a deterministic, zero-model pipeline: it segments a local capture stream into typed activity frames, bounded episodes carrying application, site, timing, input volume, and evidence pointers back to the raw rows, with no model in the loop, so the output is byte-identical, cacheable, and mechanically auditable. On one professional's single-user corpus of 128,756 frames over 51 active days, the compiler reduces a day of raw capture to a prompt-ready context block 86x smaller in 68 ms, and an agent reading that block answers questions about the day at 98.4% accuracy (Wilson 95% CI 91.7-99.7%) against an independent oracle, versus 66-80% for an LLM summary of the same capture, a mid-tier model reading the block matching a frontier one. The same compiler doubles as a demand-side cost instrument. Read off passive, pre-delegation human activity rather than agent rollouts, it supplies two parameters that agent-cost models assume but, to our knowledge, have not measured: the Routine Overhead Ratio R and the routine recurrence h. We report first values of R, a modeled upper bound, at 60-343x, and a delegable recurrence of 9.0% in-sample and 7.7% out-of-sample, for a realistic all-fleet token ceiling near 8%; a compiled routine replays deterministically with the model out of the loop, demonstrated live at zero model tokens on a guard-matched hit. Schema, compiler, and evaluation harness are open.

SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Reasoning and PlanningTopictool use / agent workflow
Qiming Shi, Yibo Dou, Jiawen Zhu, Yulong Tao, Linbo Jin, Zhaolu Kang et al.
high · 2026-08-04

Why it matters SKILL-KD turns the actionable gap between a teacher and a weaker student on the same task into testable, maintainable skill patches, enabling continued improvement without updating the frozen student model. Its trace-linked consolidation also targets skill drift caused by repeated local edits.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 10)
Method brief
01
Problem

A student failure may not reveal the missing task knowledge or operational strategy, while a teacher trajectory may be too implicit to reuse directly.

02
Method

The method contrasts the student failure with the teacher trajectory, writes a textual skill patch, re-runs the student to evaluate it, and refines the patch iteratively.

03
Difference

Instead of treating skills only as experience summaries or memory entries, it explicitly distills actionable cross-agent discrepancies and manages additions, deletions, and modifications to existing rules.

04
Evidence

Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, the paper claims consistent gains over fixed-model adaptation baselines.

Abstract

Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing skill acquisition methods often treat skills as experience summaries, memory entries, or direct summaries of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents: when a student fails because it lacks task knowledge or operational strategy, its failed trajectory may not contain enough evidence to infer the missing behavior, while the teacher trajectory may be too implicit to be internalized as reusable guidance. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates the patch by re-running the student, and iteratively refines the patch when the student still fails. To prevent repeated local updates from causing skill drift, SKILL-KD further maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation, deciding whether each patch should add a new rule, delete or modify an existing rule, or be skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.

SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding

CategoryAreaModels and Training Methods / Architecture DesignTopicmultimodal / VLM architecture
Yue Zhang, Yingzhao Jian, Yunqiu Xu, Xiaoxiao Sun, Hehe Fan
high · 2026-08-05

Why it matters SmartMage changes 3D multimodal reasoning from a fixed input recipe to query-dependent modality selection, which can reduce irrelevant semantic noise and unnecessary computation while preserving the cues most useful for each task. It is especially relevant to researchers building 3D MLLMs, embodied perception systems, or adaptive inference pipelines; the key questions are whether the routing signals are reliable and whether expert gating delivers gains beyond simply dropping modalities.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 18)
Method brief
01
Problem

Fixed modality combinations can inject irrelevant visual or geometric information into query reasoning and waste computation.

02
Method

SmartMage routes modalities using semantic priors, text-modality alignment, and modality quality, then uses modality priors to guide expert activation.

03
Difference

It adapts both the selected input modalities and the expert specialization to each query instead of applying one multimodal configuration to all queries.

04
Evidence

The paper reports leading performance on five 3D scene understanding benchmarks and finds semantic-category-specific modality preferences in the ScanFacet diagnostic benchmark.

Abstract

Understanding 3D scenes is fundamental to embodied intelligence, requiring joint reasoning over heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including visual and geometric cues. However, the relevance of these modalities often varies across queries. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically rely on fixed modality combinations, overlooking query-dependent modality needs. Such a rigid design can introduce semantic noise from irrelevant modalities while underutilizing more informative ones, leading to wasted computation and diluted reasoning. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SmartMage, a unified MLLM that dynamically orchestrates heterogeneous modalities for semantic-aware 3D scene understanding. Specifically, SmartMage incorporates: (1) a Semantic-guided Modality Adaptive RouTng (SMART) module that selects task-relevant modalities using semantic priors, text-modality alignment, and modality quality; and (2) a Modality-Aware Gating Expert (MAGE) module that leverages modality priors to guide expert activation, fostering adaptive specialization in multimodal reasoning. Empirically, SmartMage achieves state-of-the-art performance across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks, and attains competitive results on RGB-only video understanding benchmarks. In our diagnostic benchmark ScanFacet, tasks are divided into fine-grained semantic categories, enabling analysis of modality combinations preferred by each semantic type. The observed modality-semantic patterns provide further evidence of SmartMage's effectiveness. Project page: https://yuecheong.github.io/SmartMage/.

Why it matters DyPES-VLA separates cross-robot transfer into shared dynamics representation and embodiment-specific control: future prediction captures motion, contact, and interaction changes, while a mixture-of-experts head emits native actions without manual alignment of heterogeneous action spaces. Method brief
01
Problem

Generalist policies across heterogeneous robots underuse shared dynamics information and often require manual conversion into a common action format.

02
Method

The VLM learns shared query representations with a future-prediction objective, followed by an action head with shared attention and embodiment-specific feed-forward experts.

Difference

The head produces controls in each embodiment's native action space while separating shared temporal structure from embodiment-specific kinematic constraints.

Abstract

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robot manipulation, but training a single generalist policy for heterogeneous robot embodiments remains an open problem. Existing methods have two main limitations. First, they underuse dynamics priors shared across diverse visual and interaction data, limiting cross-embodiment transfer. Second, they require extensive manual preprocessing to convert embodiment-specific actions into a common format. To overcome these limitations, we propose DyPES-VLA, a cross-embodiment VLA that learns shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific control. First, we learn shared dynamics priors by training the vision-language model (VLM) with a future-prediction objective on cross-embodiment data, driving the shared query representation to capture object motion, contact, and interaction-induced scene changes. Second, an embodiment-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) action head translates these shared dynamics priors into executable controls directly in each embodiment's native action space, without manually pre-aligning heterogeneous actions into a common format. This head shares attention layers to capture common temporal action structures, while its embodiment-specific feed-forward experts resolve the unique kinematic constraints and control semantics of distinct embodiments. As a generalist policy, our \ourmethod achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-world evaluations, reaching 98.0% success on LIBERO, 59.25% on RoboCasa-GR1, and 89.02% on RoboTwin~2.0.

Are the Financial Reasoning from LLMs Credible? A Real World Test over Long-Horizon Statements

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Xinke Tong, Xuanming Zhang, Tianyi Tang, An Yang, Jiatu Hu, Guojie Lin et al.
high · 2026-07-22

Why it matters This work tests LLM numerical reasoning on uncropped financial statements of up to 32K tokens rather than cropped tables or multiple-choice items; removing formula hints drops Gemini-3.1-Pro from 70.70% to 38.22% on table tasks, exposing failures in temporal de-cumulation, stock-flow caliber matching, and multi-period table construction, while SFT partially restores performance.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 14)
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing financial reasoning benchmarks rely mainly on multiple-choice questions, single-hop QA, and cropped tables, missing cross-statement dynamics and temporal de-cumulation.

02
Method

FinIndices uses an automated synthesis pipeline with adversarial traps to test Single-Index computation and Table-Index tabulation over uncropped statements.

03
Difference

The benchmark combines long contexts with domain, temporal, caliber, and multi-metric multi-period reasoning, including comparisons with and without explicit formula hints.

04

Abstract

Do Large Language Models (LLMs) possess genuine structural reasoning, or merely rely on surface-level pattern matching? The financial domain, demanding numerical precision and multi-step logic over long contexts, is an ideal testbed. Existing benchmarks fail to capture real-world industrial complexity, predominantly relying on multiple-choice questions or single-hop QA over cropped tables while ignoring intricate cross-statement dynamics and temporal de-cumulation. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinIndices, a large-scale benchmark evaluating data-processing fidelity over uncropped financial statements (up to 32K tokens). Utilizing an automated synthesis pipeline with adversarial traps, FinIndices encompasses Single-Index computation and Table-Index tabulation to test complex domain, temporal, and caliber reasoning. Our evaluation reveals two severe LLM vulnerabilities. First, a "Knowledge Bottleneck": despite memorizing formulas during pre-training, models demonstrate fragile pattern matching. Removing explicit formula hints causes performance to collapse (e.g., Gemini-3.1-Pro drops from 70.70% to 38.22% on table tasks), exposing fatal flaws in temporal de-cumulation and stock-flow caliber mismatch. Second, a "Structural Bottleneck": the intense cognitive load of generating multi-metric, multi-period tables actively drains reasoning capacity. Under structural pressure, LLMs that flawlessly execute isolated derivations regress to shallow heuristics, such as fetching incorrect adjacent columns or substituting deep accounting adjustments with lazy literal arithmetic. Finally, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) yields substantial zero-hint gains (+8.54% Single, +3.82% Table), validating that structured logic can be partially restored via data-centric alignment.

论文 / 补充信号

DG-FedReuse: Proxy-Gradient-Gated Cached-Update Reuse with Matched Sparse Uplink Accounting

Rahil Aftab, Vineet Kumar Rakesh, Soumya Mazumdar, Tapas Samanta
low · 2026-08-05

为什么值得看 这项工作与分布式训练的通信压缩有关：在联邦学习中，它用带年龄衰减的缓存更新减少上行传输，并报告相对匹配的稀疏联邦平均方法额外节省约百分之六至百分之八的模型更新数据字段。不过证据只来自模拟器，且对称计入模型下行后节省降至百分之四十一点六八至百分之四十二点七一，尚不能说明真实带宽、运行时间或能耗收益。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

联邦学习需要反复执行客户端本地优化并传输模型更新，因此上行通信成本较高。

02
方法

机制按梯度差异代理和轮次阈值选择缓存更新，并结合缓存年龄上限、新鲜客户端配额和按张量前百分比编码。

03
差异

与匹配的稀疏联邦平均基线相比，它复用带年龄衰减的历史客户端更新，而不是只压缩新鲜更新。

04
证据

在六个数据集和三个种子上，九十轮预算下报告百分之八十三点三六至百分之八十五点四二的模型更新字段上行节省，但准确率差异为负百分之五点二九至负百分之零点一四。

摘要

联邦学习反复承担本地优化和模型更新传输的开销。本文研究一种模拟器级机制：当随机头部梯度差异代理低于随轮次变化的阈值时，允许选定客户端贡献经过年龄衰减的缓存更新；该机制同时设置缓存最大年龄和新鲜客户端最低配额，新鲜更新则采用按张量自适应的前百分比数值字段表示。在六个图像分类数据集、五十个虚拟客户端、狄利克雷标签异质性参数为零点五和三个随机种子的实验中，在共同九十轮预算下，该方法相对匹配的稀疏联邦平均方法将模型更新数据字段上行量额外减少到百分之八十三点三六至百分之八十五点四二，而后者为百分之七十六点八八；按种子对齐的准确率差异为负百分之五点二九至负百分之零点一四。研究只刻画了所实现模拟器中的复用规则，未证明无偏泛化、端到端带宽降低、运行时间或能耗节省、更快收敛，或优于已有的陈旧更新和惰性聚合方法。

From Passive Mirrors to Active Agents: Holonic Digital Twins for Physical AI over Networks

Christo Kurisummoottil Thomas, Omar Hashash, Walid Saad
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 这项工作把无线网络和边缘节点视为物理智能的协同推理基础，而不是只优化吞吐、时延和可靠性；它对需要机器人、车辆在不确定环境中共享时空状态的系统架构研究有参考价值，但摘要没有给出实现、基准或性能证据。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

传统无线网络架构主要优化吞吐、时延和可靠性，不能为物理智能体提供实时协同所需的共享时空语境。

02
方法

方法构建由分层全息数字孪生组成的网络，并结合主动推理、因果马尔可夫毯、范畴论和整合信息论。

03
差异

它让数字孪生主动推理、选择性传输信念并与邻近智能体形成集体单元，而不是被动镜像物理资产。

04
证据

摘要只描述架构原则和理论组件，未报告实验、系统实现或量化结果。

摘要

现有深度学习和生成式人工智能嵌入机器人、车辆等物理系统后，仍难以在物理约束下维护可靠的世界模型、进行长时域规划并泛化到未见场景。论文提出全息数字孪生网络，通过连接物理智能体与网络边缘的分层数字孪生，使各智能体在本地自主推理并与邻近孪生体协作；因果马尔可夫毯决定协作范围，主动推理根据接收者的认知价值选择传输信念，范畴论保持异构表示间的语义结构，整合信息论则衡量协同智能相对独立运行的增益。

潜力 21新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
3 位作者0 所机构2 条合作线
03
论文 / 补充信号

Breaking Memory Bottlenecks in Quantum Control Systems for More Precise Experiments and Higher Throughput Computing

Yicheng Guang, Neel Vora, Yilun Xu, Yueqi Chen, Gang Huang
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 这项工作主要面向量子控制系统，而不是人工智能基础设施；其价值在于展示了片上存储与外部存储协同、确定性时序和流水执行的系统设计思路，可能对关注专用加速器运行时的研究者有参考意义。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

量子控制层的片上块存储容量有限，而外部动态存储具有非确定性延迟。

02
方法

系统将外部动态存储与片上块存储组成存储层次，并通过流水化执行保持电路间时序确定。

03
差异

它不是单纯扩大片上存储，而是用两级存储协同降低电路加载与读出对执行的阻塞。

04
证据

在二十六个真实实验与计算电路上，论文报告加载和读出开销降至接近零，并已部分集成到量子控制平台三点零。

摘要

量子控制系统受限于片上存储容量不足以及外部存储延迟不确定，难以同时支持更精确的实验和更高的电路吞吐量。论文提出一种结合外部动态存储与片上块存储的存储层次设计，以支持流水化量子电路执行并保证电路间时序确定性；在二十六个真实实验与计算电路上的评估表明，该设计支持一量子比特和二量子比特随机基准测试中的深电路，并将电路加载和读出上行相对执行时间的开销从百分之二十二点九至百分之一千四百一十七点零五降至接近零。

潜力 20新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
5 位作者0 所机构4 条合作线
04
论文 / 补充信号

GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming

Yijie Bian, Wei Guo, Zixin Wang, Shenghui Song, Jun Zhang, Khaled B. Letaief
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 这项工作主要面向无线通信而非人工智能基础设施；它把环境几何、三维高斯表示和电磁传播建模结合起来，在不依赖在线瞬时信道状态信息的情况下生成波束，只有在研究无线加速器或通信感知硬件时才值得关注。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

传统波束成形需要瞬时信道状态信息和迭代优化，增加导频开销与计算成本。

02
方法

方法用双向球面高斯核表示环境散射响应，并通过双侧电磁光栅化渲染角度传播图。

03
差异

它从接入点姿态和用户位置直接合成恒模波束，而不是在线估计瞬时信道后进行优化。

04
证据

仿真声称在延迟方面持续优于穷举波束对齐等基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。

摘要

波束成形通常依赖准确的瞬时信道状态信息和迭代优化，因此会带来较高的导频开销与计算复杂度。该方法利用多模态数据建立持久的三维高斯环境表示，通过保持互易性的双向球面高斯核和双侧电磁光栅化生成角度传播图，再结合阵列流形字典合成恒模波束，使系统能够根据接入点姿态和用户位置直接生成波束而无需在线瞬时信道状态信息；仿真显示其延迟低于包括穷举波束对齐在内的基线方法。

TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure

分类方向推理系统 / Serving 引擎主题LLM serving / inference engines
Yuhan Zhou, Yuchu Luo, Hao Nie, Wangrunze Lv, Yu Zhou, Yibo Zhu et al.
high · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 这项工作把模型权重、键值缓存、检查点状态和请求路由纳入同一套可编程张量生命周期管理层，减少推理引擎、网络和存储后端之间的专用集成。它已接入主流推理系统，并在高并发多轮智能体负载下将首次令牌时间的中位数最多降低百分之九十三点二，适合关注跨组件状态复用和推理服务优化的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

权重物化、权重同步、键值缓存和检查点同步由彼此隔离的专用机制管理，难以复用跨组件策略。

02
方法

系统提供一等张量抽象、可编程生命周期原语和将管理策略与执行机制分离的分布式运行时。

03
差异

开发者通过统一接口编写张量管理程序，而系统透明地处理分布式执行与数据移动。

04
证据

作者在两个推理引擎和多类张量生命周期负载上评估系统，并报告其性能可与专用方案竞争。

摘要

现有大语言模型基础设施通常针对权重加载、键值缓存和检查点同步等任务分别设计张量管理机制，这些专用方案形成彼此隔离的系统，阻碍了管理策略的复用与组合。本文将张量生命周期管理定义为大语言模型基础设施中缺失的抽象层，提出张量即服务，并构建张量铸造系统，将张量状态管理与计算逻辑解耦，提供一等张量抽象、可编程生命周期原语和分离策略与执行机制的运行时；该系统接入两个推理引擎，在多类张量生命周期负载上取得了与专用系统相当的性能，并在高并发多轮智能体负载下将首次令牌时间中位数最多降低百分之九十三点二。

8 位作者1 所机构12 条合作线

论文 / 高优先级

PLoRA: An NDP-Enhanced Pooled-Memory System for Cost-Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving

分类方向推理系统 / Serving 引擎主题LLM serving / inference engines
Zhongkai Yu, Ohm Rishabh Venkatachalam, Zheng Wang, Yikai Li, Yichen Lin, Zihao Yu et al.
high · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对多适配器推理中的内存与数据搬运瓶颈：它把适配器和键值缓存放入可池化内存，并在数据附近计算，只通过互连返回压缩结果，从而减少逐请求经过主机内存和高速互连的搬运。对需要在单个加速器上服务上千个低秩适配器的系统，论文报告其在一千个适配器和一块高端加速器上相比真实机器基线平均降低解码延迟六点六倍，同时额外设备面积低于百分之三点四。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

多低秩适配器服务需要处理远超加速器显存容量的适配器和键值缓存，同时避免外围组件互连上的主机搬运开销。

02
方法

系统把适配器和键值缓存放入池化内存，在近数据处理侧执行计算，并由图形处理器驱动读计算接口。

03

DG-FedReuse: Proxy-Gradient-Gated Cached-Update Reuse with Matched Sparse Uplink Accounting

Rahil Aftab, Vineet Kumar Rakesh, Soumya Mazumdar, Tapas Samanta
low · 2026-08-05

Why it matters This paper targets communication-efficient federated training: it reuses age-decayed cached client updates to reduce uplink traffic and reports roughly 6–9 percentage points more modeled update-field savings than matched Top-K FedAvg. The result is simulator-only, and symmetric accounting for model downlink cuts total modeled savings to 41.68–42.71%, so it does not establish real bandwidth, runtime, or energy gains.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Federated learning repeatedly pays for local optimization and client-to-server model-update transmission.

02
Method

The mechanism selects cached updates using a stochastic head-gradient discrepancy proxy and round-dependent threshold, with cache-age, fresh-client, and per-tensor Top-K constraints.

03
Difference

Unlike a baseline that only sparsifies fresh updates, it reuses age-decayed historical client updates when the proxy indicates that reuse is acceptable.

04
Evidence

Across six image-classification datasets and three seeds, the 90-round experiments report 83.36–85.42% modeled update-field uplink savings, while seed-aligned accuracy changes range from -5.29 to -0.14 percentage points.

Abstract

Federated learning repeatedly incurs local optimization and model-update transmission. We study DG-FedReuse, a simulator-level mechanism that allows selected clients to contribute age-decayed cached updates when a stochastic head-gradient discrepancy proxy remains below a round-dependent threshold. A hard cache-age limit and minimum fresh-client quota constrain reuse, while fresh updates use an adaptive per-tensor Top-K numerical-field representation. Experiments cover six image-classification datasets, 50 virtual clients, Dirichlet label heterogeneity (α=0.5), and three seeds. At a common 90-round budget, DG-FedReuse yields 83.36-85.42% modeled update-data-field uplink saving, compared with 76.88% for matched Top-K FedAvg; the seed-aligned accuracy differences range from -5.29 to -0.14 percentage points. Best-observed test accuracies obtained under test-controlled checkpointing are retained only as exploratory archival evidence and range from -2.38 to +0.45 percentage points relative to matched FedAvg. A symmetric dense-model-downlink sensitivity reduces the headline saving to 41.68-F42.71% and the incremental gain over Top-K FedAvg to 3.24-4.27 percentage points, demonstrating the dependence of communication conclusions on the accounting boundary. The study characterizes the proposed reuse rule in the implemented simulator; it does not establish unbiased generalization, end-to-end bandwidth reduction, runtime or energy savings, faster convergence, or superiority over existing stale-update and lazy-aggregation methods.

From Passive Mirrors to Active Agents: Holonic Digital Twins for Physical AI over Networks

Christo Kurisummoottil Thomas, Omar Hashash, Walid Saad
low · 2026-08-06

Why it matters The paper treats wireless networks and edge nodes as a coordination substrate for physical-AI inference rather than optimizing only throughput, latency, and reliability; this may inform architectures for robots and vehicles that share spatiotemporal state under uncertainty, but the abstract gives no implementation, benchmark, or performance evidence.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Conventional wireless architectures optimize throughput, latency, and reliability but do not provide the shared spatiotemporal context needed for real-time physical-AI coordination.

02
Method

The framework builds a network of hierarchical holonic digital twins and combines active inference, causal Markov blankets, category theory, and integrated information theory.

03
Difference

Digital twins actively reason, selectively transmit beliefs, and cooperate with neighboring agents instead of passively mirroring physical assets.

04
Evidence

The abstract describes architectural principles and theoretical components but reports no experiments, implementation, or quantitative results.

Abstract

Despite advances in artificial intelligence (AI) across multiple sectors, today's AI tools, including deep learning and generative AI, still fail when embedded into physical systems, such as robots and vehicles operating under real-world physical laws. This stems from their inability to maintain reliable world models for long-horizon planning under uncertainty and generalize to unseen scenarios. In this context, wireless networks, through pervasive sensing and communication, can orchestrate physical intelligence. However, current architectures optimize throughput, latency, and reliability and cannot support real-time physical AI coordination, requiring agents to maintain shared spatiotemporal context. To address these challenges, a network of holonic digital twins (HDT-Nets) framework is proposed to deliver real-time physical AI inference through holonic agents that actively reason about their environment rather than passively mirror physical assets. Each HDT is realized as a hierarchical structure spanning the physical agent and network edge, reasoning autonomously at the local level while cooperating with neighboring HDTs to form collectively intelligent units. In HDT-Net, causal Markov blankets spanning sensing, communication, and control determine which agents must coordinate and enable counterfactual reasoning over multi-domain interventions. Active inference within these boundaries unifies perception, action, and learning by minimizing expected free energy while deciding which beliefs to transmit based on their cognitive value to the receiver. Category theory ensures that transmitted beliefs preserve semantic structure across heterogeneous agents with incompatible representations. Finally, integrated information theory quantifies when collective intelligence exceeds independent operation and how network intelligence evolves through coordinated learning and information exchange.

Yicheng Guang, Neel Vora, Yilun Xu, Yueqi Chen, Gang Huang
low · 2026-08-06

Why it matters This paper targets quantum control systems rather than AI infrastructure, so its direct relevance is limited; its memory-hierarchy and deterministic-timing design may still interest researchers working on runtimes for specialized accelerators.

Method brief
01
Problem

02
Method

Abstract

As quantum computing continues to demonstrate promise and attract growing attention, there is an increasing need for more precise experiments to advance the development of quantum devices, as well as higher circuit throughput to validate more domain applications. However, this need is hindered by a memory bottleneck at the quantum control system layer, arising from limited on-chip BRAM capacity and the non-deterministic latency of DRAM. To break this bottleneck, we present Ant-Q, a memory hierarchy design that integrates DRAM with BRAM to support pipelined quantum circuit execution while ensuring deterministic inter-circuit timing. We evaluated Ant-Q using 26 real-world experimental and computing circuits. The results show that Ant-Q supports deep circuits for 1Q and 2Q Randomized Benchmarking and reduces the overhead of circuit loading and readout uplink relative to execution time from 22.90%-1417.05% to near zero. Ant-Q is being integrated into QubiC 3.0, with part of its functionalities already available.

GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming

Yijie Bian, Wei Guo, Zixin Wang, Shenghui Song, Jun Zhang, Khaled B. Letaief
low · 2026-08-06

Why it matters This is primarily a wireless-communications paper rather than an AI-infrastructure paper. It may matter to researchers building wireless accelerators or communication-aware hardware because it uses persistent 3D environmental geometry to generate beams without online instantaneous CSI, but it does not address training, serving, compilers, kernels, or clusters.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Conventional beamforming depends on instantaneous CSI and iterative optimization, creating pilot overhead and computational cost.

02
Method

GSBF represents environmental scattering with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian kernels and renders an angular propagator map through two-sided electromagnetic rasterization.

03
Difference

It synthesizes constant-modulus beams from AP pose and user position instead of optimizing beams from online instantaneous CSI.

04
Evidence

The abstract reports lower latency than baselines including exhaustive beam alignment in simulation, without giving numerical results.

Abstract

Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. The rendered map is then aggregated through an over-complete array-manifold dictionary and projected to the constant-modulus beamformers, thereby synthesizing beams directly from the access point (AP) pose and user position without online instantaneous CSI. Simulations demonstrate that GSBF consistently outperforms baselines such as exhaustive beam alignment (EBA) with lower latency.

TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure

CategoryAreaInference Systems / Serving EnginesTopicLLM serving / inference engines
Yuhan Zhou, Yuchu Luo, Hao Nie, Wangrunze Lv, Yu Zhou, Yibo Zhu et al.
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters TensorCast gives LLM serving stacks one programmable layer for model weights, KV caches, checkpoints, and request-routing state instead of separate integrations with engines, networks, and storage. Its integration with vLLM and SGLang shows a practical path to cross-component policies; under highly concurrent multi-turn agent workloads, one such policy improves median time to first token by up to 93.2%.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Task-specific tensor managers for weight loading, KV caches, checkpoint synchronization, and related workloads form isolated silos.

02
Method

TensorCast implements Tensor-as-a-Service with first-class tensor objects, programmable lifecycle primitives, and a runtime that separates policies from execution mechanisms.

03
Difference

Applications express tensor management through common APIs while the runtime transparently performs distributed execution and data movement.

04
Evidence

The system is integrated with vLLM and SGLang and evaluated on weight materialization, weight synchronization, KV cache management, and programmable request routing.

Abstract

Modern LLM infrastructure increasingly manages tensors not only as computation data, but also as persistent states shared across distributed components. Existing systems optimize individual tensor management tasks, such as model weight loading, KV cache management, and checkpoint synchronization, by deeply integrating task-specific mechanisms with execution engines, networks, or storage backends. However, this specialization creates isolated silos that hinder the reuse and composition of tensor management strategies across evolving LLM workloads. In this paper, we identify tensor lifecycle management as a missing abstraction layer in LLM infrastructure and propose Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS), which decouples tensor state management from computation logic. We design and build TensorCast, a distributed tensor management layer that provides first-class tensor abstractions, programmable lifecycle primitives, and a runtime that separates tensor management policies from execution mechanisms. This enables developers to write tensor management programs using TensorCast APIs while transparently leveraging distributed execution and data movement. We integrate TensorCast with vLLM and SGLang and evaluate it across diverse tensor lifecycle workloads, including model weight materialization, weight synchronization, KV cache management, and programmable request routing. Our results show that TensorCast achieves competitive performance with specialized tensor management systems while enabling new cross-component optimization policies. A programmable policy implemented with TensorCast improves median TTFT by up to 93.2% under highly concurrent multi-turn agent workloads.

PLoRA: An NDP-Enhanced Pooled-Memory System for Cost-Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving

CategoryAreaInference Systems / Serving EnginesTopicLLM serving / inference engines
Zhongkai Yu, Ohm Rishabh Venkatachalam, Zheng Wang, Yikai Li, Yichen Lin, Zihao Yu et al.
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters This work targets the core systems bottleneck in multi-adapter inference: moving adapter weights and KV state rather than performing arithmetic. By keeping both in pooled memory and computing near the data, PLoRA reduces host-staged transfers; on one H100 serving 1,000 adapters, it reports 6.6x lower average decode latency than real-machine S-LoRA with under 3.4% added device area.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Multi-LoRA serving must manage adapter and KV-cache capacity at terabyte scale while avoiding per-access CPU-DRAM and PCIe staging overhead.

02
Method

PLoRA uses an NDP-enhanced pooled-memory architecture with a GPU-driven read-compute interface and keeps adapters and KV cache in the pool.

03
Difference

A link-parameterized cost model selects among four LoRA and two attention execution strategies while caching the most performance-critical bytes in GPU memory.

04
Evidence

For one H100 serving 1,000 adapters, the paper reports the lowest measured decode latency across every model and workload, averaging 6.6x below real-machine S-LoRA with under 3.4% added device area.

Abstract

Multi-LoRA serving is how one base model becomes thousands of specialized variants, one adapter per user, task, or agent, and the deployments can hold 1000-plus adapters. Serving them is hard because the workload inverts what GPUs provide: terabytes of memory against only tens of TFLOPS, and because every published system stages its adapters from CPU DRAM over PCIe, where each access pays a kernel stop and a host-run copy and capacity ends at the motherboard's DIMM slots. Meanwhile, memory-semantic fabrics such as CXL and NVLink are converging on pooled memory that an accelerator addresses with its own loads and stores, and near-data processing (NDP) can place compute beside the pooled data. How to serve multi-LoRA workloads on such hardware remains unexplored. This paper introduces PLoRA, an NDP-enhanced pooled-memory system for cost-efficient multi-LoRA serving. PLoRA keeps adapters and KV cache in the pool and returns only reduced results over the link, through a read-compute interface the GPU drives with its own loads and stores. Above this architecture, a GPU memory management system picks among four LoRA and two attention execution strategies for each adapter and caches the most performance-critical bytes in GPU memory, guided by a link-parameterized cost model. On one H100 serving 1000 adapters, PLoRA attains the lowest decode latency on every model and workload we measure, averaging 6.6x below a real-machine S-LoRA at under 3.4% added device area. The link itself stops mattering: throughput saturates at 32 GB/s on short contexts, a quarter of CXL 3.1, and the verdict survives scale: per-GPU demand falls from 7B to a modeled 1.2T deployment once adapter traffic shards with the tensor parallelism. The design runs unchanged from CXL-class to NVLink-class fabrics, and surplus bandwidth buys pooled capacity rather than speed.

Hybrid-Adaptive Thread Tuning to Mitigate Simulation Execution Bottlenecks in High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Inference

CategoryAreaTraining Systems / Cluster Scheduling and ReliabilityTopicresource management / elasticity
Jiming Su, Hantao Hua, Lujia Yin, Yiping Yao, Feng Zhu
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters The paper treats simulator thread count as a dynamic resource-allocation problem in RL inference rather than a fixed setting. For simulation-heavy decision systems, it combines queueing constraints with online tuning and reports an 18.4% average speedup over static strategies, with execution-time reductions of up to 83.8%.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Changing ratios between task execution and scheduling time make fixed or preselected thread counts cause contention and scheduling overhead.

02
Method

AutoThread predicts thread counts with a Physics-Informed Neural Operator, constrains the prediction with a finite-source M/M/1 queueing model, and applies load-aware online fine-tuning.

03
Difference

The method combines pre-execution prediction with runtime correction instead of relying only on static settings or a single predictor.

04
Evidence

The experiments report an 18.4% average speedup over static strategies, 1.7x and 1.8x the average throughput of XGBoost and Reinforcer, and up to 83.8% lower execution time than prior methods.

Abstract

In simulation-in-the-loop decision-making systems, reinforcement learning (RL) inference is often constrained by simulator-side execution overhead, where workloads are highly dynamic and sensitive to runtime thread configurations. Existing multithreaded strategies struggle to match thread resources before or during execution, causing resource contention, scheduling overhead, and reduced throughput. Through empirical analysis, we identify the ratio of task execution time to scheduling time as the key factor determining the optimal thread count. Building on this insight, we propose AutoThread, a hybrid adaptive thread-tuning method for mitigating simulation bottlenecks in RL inference. AutoThread employs a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) as a thread-count predictor and incorporates a finite-source M/M/1 queueing model to constrain and guide prediction, enabling fast and accurate estimation under dynamic workloads. It further performs load-aware online fine-tuning to compensate for prediction errors and refine resource allocation. Experiments show that AutoThread improves average speedup by 18.4\% over static strategies, achieves average throughput of 1.7x and 1.8x that of XGBoost and Reinforcer, respectively, and reduces execution time by up to 83.8\% compared with state-of-the-art methods. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/suchenjm/AutoThread.

Routing LLM Inference to the Cleanest Grid in Real Time

CategoryAreaTraining Systems / Cluster Scheduling and ReliabilityTopicresource management / elasticity
Aleks Bernhard, Arif Baran Yardimci
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters This work turns carbon-aware inference routing into a reversible overlay on a production router, using GPU telemetry and historical marginal emissions for request-level accounting. It shows how multi-region GPU operators can reduce modeled operational emissions without retraining or hardware changes, while exposing the gap between replay-based savings and savings achievable with forecast error.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Multi-region inference placement usually ignores large spatial and temporal changes in marginal grid carbon intensity.

02
Method

The system routes requests by marginal operating emissions rate on top of a production pressure-based router, then attributes energy with GPU telemetry and settles emissions against historical signals.

03
Difference

The evaluation uses a real production pressure router rather than uniform placement as the blind baseline and compares regions by absolute emissions rate rather than region-normalized percentile signals.

04
Evidence

The live multi-region testbed observed no dispatch failures, while a one-year historical replay reports a 50.9% modeled reduction versus round-robin with a 95% block-bootstrap confidence interval of 48.5–53.3%.

Abstract

Large-language-model inference is a fast-growing electricity load whose marginal carbon intensity varies by more than an order of magnitude across grid regions and across the day, making request placement an attractive lever: no retraining, no hardware change. We report a live validation of carbon-aware inference routing on multi-region GPU testbeds driven by marginal operating emissions rate (MOER) signals, with three properties uncommon in prior work: a blind baseline that is an actual production pressure-based router rather than uniform placement; per-request energy attributed from GPU telemetry (NVIDIA DCGM) via measured concurrency curves rather than nameplate TDP; and carbon settlement of every request against historical MOER, not only the forecast that drove the decision. The central live result is feasibility: a MOER signal steered inference across regions with no observed dispatch failures, as a strict and reversible overlay on the production router. To size the effect, we replay a year of hourly MOER across a grid-diverse CONUS fleet. In the primary modeled configuration, carbon-aware placement reduces modeled GPU-attributable operational emissions by 50.9% versus round-robin (95% block-bootstrap CI 48.5-53.3%). Because the replay dispatches against historical MOER rather than a forecast, this is an upper bound under that configuration; forecast error would reduce operationally realized savings. Before session pinning, hourly lowest-MOER routing contributes about 22.4 percentage points, roughly 40% of the 54.0% placement reduction, beyond a static annual-mean-MOER policy. These are modeled results for one fleet and historical year, not a universal estimate. We also record a practical observation: when comparing regions, rank by absolute MOER rather than the percentile signal-index, which is normalized within each region and answers a temporal, not a spatial, question.

BALANCE: Hybrid Autoregressive-Speculative LLM Inference in Wireless Edge Networks

CategoryAreaInference Systems / Serving EnginesTopicbatching / routing / latency
Guanqiao Qu, Shuo Chen, Qian Chen, Kin K. Leung, Xianhao Chen
high · 2026-08-06

Why it matters The paper treats autoregressive and speculative decoding as schedulable service modes, letting an edge server trade memory, compute, and latency across heterogeneous users instead of committing to one decoder. This is directly useful for edge inference operators that need to maximize concurrent task throughput under server memory limits.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

An edge server must serve users with different latency requirements while sharing limited memory and compute between autoregressive and speculative decoding.

02
Method

BALANCE co-hosts a small language model and a large language model, then jointly assigns users to decoding modes and allocates computing resources.

03
Difference

The method decomposes the NP-hard throughput maximization problem into two sub-problems and solves it with a polynomial-time algorithm offering a constant approximation guarantee.

04
Evidence

Experiments are reported to consistently outperform standalone autoregressive and speculative decoding and to significantly increase task throughput.

Abstract

Edge inference is a promising paradigm to provide large language model (LLM) inference services in next-generation mobile networks. LLM inference mainly relies on two approaches: Autoregressive decoding (AD) generates output tokens sequentially, resulting in long latency; Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates inference by using a small language model (SLM) to generate multiple draft tokens for LLM verification, but incurs extra memory costs. Due to this latency-memory tradeoff, neither approach alone can efficiently serve users with heterogeneous demands under limited edge computing resources. To address this challenge, we propose a hybrid autoregressive-speculative inference (BALANCE) framework for edge LLM inference. In BALANCE, an edge server hosts both an SLM and an LLM, assigns each user to AD or SD, and performs the two modes simultaneously. To maximize the number of served users, we formulate a task throughput maximization problem to jointly determine user scheduling and computing resource allocation between AD and SD under user latency requirements and server memory constraints. Since the problem is NP-hard, we develop a polynomial-time algorithm that transforms the original problem into two sub-problems and obtains a sub-optimal solution with a constant approximation guarantee. Experiments demonstrate that BALANCE consistently outperforms conventional AD and SD and significantly improves task throughput.

Method brief

Problem

Existing inference schedulers often assume fixed-rate Poisson arrivals and therefore do not represent bursty, time-varying traffic.

02

The extension estimates request intensity online from observed interarrival times and feeds that estimate into the WAIT algorithm.

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and Claude are widely used for information retrieval and problem-solving. Recent work has focused on improving scheduling algorithms to boost throughput while maintaining low latency. However, these approaches often assume Poisson request arrivals with constant rates - an assumption that fails to reflect the inherently bursty and dynamic nature of real-world traffic. We propose a lightweight extension to the state-of-the-art WAIT algorithm [1], which adapts to time-varying arrival rates without prior traffic knowledge. The proposed algorithm performs online estimation of request intensity based on observed interarrival times. Using Markov Modulated Poisson Process (MMPP)-based synthetic workloads with diverse request types, we conduct a simulation-based evaluation demonstrating that the proposed method achieves higher throughput than Sarathi-Serve [2], ORCA [3], and vLLM [4] in the evaluated low arrival-rate shift scenarios while maintaining comparable latency.

Why it matters This gives serving teams a way to budget and attribute risk across compressed KV caches, latent caches, sparse selectors, and recurrent states instead of treating memory corruption as an undifferentiated error signal. Method brief
01
Problem

Different attention-memory representations fail differently under compression, eviction, and slot reuse, making request-level guarantees difficult to compose.

02
Method

The system uses three observation operators, metric-typed contracts, two proved metric bridges, and machine-selected certification tiers to build an executable risk ledger.

The checker rejects composition across mismatched metrics, while unsupported formal claims are automatically downgraded to empirical status rather than presented as certified.

Abstract

Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Applied to a served DeepSeek-V4 stack with a packed compressed-KV prototype, the same machinery localizes a silent corruption to a precise structural boundary -- exact in the eviction-free, identity-isolated regime, with every observed failure in an eviction or slot-reuse regime -- through a machine-adjudicated discrimination campaign whose calculus rejected two of our own confounded inferences along the way. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory; every number in this paper regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.

Why it matters This paper targets the external-memory bottleneck of on-device LLM inference and addresses the conflict between mixture-of-experts routing and speculative decoding in one hardware-software design. Method brief
01
Problem

Mixture-of-experts inference increases external-memory access, while its routing behavior is incompatible with speculative decoding.

02
Method

The design builds a shared expert set from important prompt tokens during prefill and coalesces same-depth candidate experts while loading salient channels during decode.

03
Difference

Instead of loading the union of all required channels, it combines prompt-level expert reuse, sparse routing, selective channel loading, and computational calibration.

Abstract

On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. In the prefill stage, the prompt-wise expert reuse reformulates routing as prompt-level expert reuse rather than independent per-token expert selection. It identifies important tokens using a lightweight encoder, constructs a shared expert set from them, and routes less important tokens with a reduced expert budget to lower expert EMA. In the decode stage, depth-aware expert coalescing exploits the contextual similarity and mutual exclusivity of same-depth candidate tokens. Rather than loading the union of all required channels, EdgeXpert loads only salient channels and applies computational calibration to recover accuracy without additional memory access. Problem

The report examines how to diagnose throughput anomalies, communication hangs, and data-parallel deadlocks during multi-node full fine-tuning on a new GPU platform.

01
Problem

Contraction plans with similar theoretical complexity can behave very differently on GPUs because of execution-level structure.

02
Method

The system extracts structural features from pairwise-contraction sequences and trains gradient-boosted rankers with listwise and pairwise objectives on GPU measurements.

robotics.body:
01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题embodied agents

01
论文 / 重点关注

EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

分类主题embodied agents
Zishan Xu, Zhiyuan Yao, Yuxin Chen, Yifu Guo, Zhengxi Lu, Yuquan Lu et al.
medium · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它展示了一条减少真实或合成环境依赖的智能体训练路线：策略在生成工具调用后自行排演环境响应，并把这种动作—结果关系内化为可用于决策的世界模型，这对需要长时工具交互但缺少可靠模拟器的具身智能体训练尤其有价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 34）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

长时工具使用智能体依赖构建和验证成本高的可执行环境，外部模拟器也难以与任务真实对应。

02
方法

环境角色和策略角色交替生成工具调用及其诱发响应，并通过任务成功奖励对两者进行端到端联合优化。

03
差异

训练阶段用策略内部的世界排演替代外部环境交互，测试时还可在执行前进行私有排演。

04
证据

在四个工具使用基准上，方法整体表现超过依赖环境扩展的基线，且受控实验显示不同模型规模都能从排演中获益。

摘要

EnvACE训练智能体先生成工具调用，再自行扮演环境生成该动作诱发的响应，并基于排演结果继续决策；策略与环境角色通过任务成功奖励联合优化，从而将动作与环境响应的关系内化到参数中。实验显示，该方法在多个工具使用基准上取得较强且可迁移的表现，并在测试时通过有限预算的执行前排演进一步提升效果，同时减少额外交互需求。

潜力 60新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
12 位作者6 所机构11 条合作线
02
论文 / 高优先级

Weights or Skills? A Survey of Robot-Learning Techniques: from Action-Predicting Weights to Robots that Write their Own Skills

分类主题embodied agents
Gaytri Jena, Kapil Wanaskar, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Vasu Sharma, Amitava Das
high · 2026-08-03

为什么值得看 它为机器人研究者提供一套区分冻结策略模型与可执行自改进技能的统一坐标，并明确指出把执行反馈、技能记忆和进化搜索闭合起来仍是少数系统才触及的空白，从而帮助选择研究路线并定位跨本体迁移、安全验证和技能组合等关键问题。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 6）
方法解读
01
问题

论文试图整理机器人学习中将能力固化在权重里与让智能体编写可执行技能代码的两条路线。

02
方法

作者以权重与技能为主轴，按自我改进程度组织代码策略方法，并覆盖六类技术中的七十七个代表系统。

03
差异

该分类把代码策略从零样本程序合成、闭环自修复和持久技能记忆推进到结合执行反馈、技能记忆与进化搜索的开放循环。

04
证据

论文指出只有少数近期系统进入最后一类，并分析商业技能市场中静态回放及适应性、跨本体迁移、溯源和安全验证等缺口。

摘要

这篇综述将机器人学习概括为两种取向：把能力固化在视觉语言动作模型权重中的策略，以及编写并持续改进可执行技能代码的智能体。文章围绕这一轴线整理六类技术中的七十七个代表系统，细分自我改进机制和“技能”的不同含义，并将其连接到机器人技能市场及适应、跨本体迁移、安全验证、组合与标准化等开放问题。

潜力 46新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
6 位作者0 所机构5 条合作线
03
论文 / 高优先级

XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?

分类主题embodied agents
Yixiang Chen, Jiabing Yang, Yuan Xu, Qisen Ma, Keji He, Peiyan Li et al.
high · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它用跨机器人、同场景的受控测试揭示现有动作条件世界模型主要依赖二维外观相似性而非物理运动学，因此为操控研究者明确指出：要让模型零样本迁移到新形态机器人，必须分离视觉外观与底层动力学，并结合像素空间动作和显式时空对齐。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文检验动作条件世界模型能否在物理场景相同但机器人形态未见过的情况下生成可信视觉轨迹。

02
方法

作者建立跨形态测试平台，在相同场景中评估模型对留出机器人的渲染与动作响应。

03
差异

分析将外观相似性、物理运动学相似性、像素空间动作和时空对齐对泛化的影响分开考察。

04
证据

实验显示模型难以把数值关节动作转成连贯视觉轨迹，零样本迁移失败，少样本适配还会遗忘已见机器人。

摘要

论文提出跨形态受控测试平台，在物理场景完全相同的条件下评估世界模型对未见机器人形态的泛化能力。系统分析表明，现有模型更像二维视觉模式匹配器，泛化主要由视觉相似性决定，而不是物理运动学相似性；它们难以从静态初始观测预测动态视觉变化，也难以将抽象数值关节动作转化为连贯轨迹。论文进一步指出，零样本生成未见形态需要像素空间动作和显式时空对齐，即使通过少样本适配绕过这一障碍，也会导致已见形态的灾难性遗忘，因此真正的跨形态泛化需要把视觉外观与物理动力学解耦。

潜力 32新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
12 位作者2 所机构11 条合作线

主题imitation / policy learning

04
论文 / 重点关注

Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Reinforcement Learning for Visual Continuous Control

分类主题imitation / policy learning
Xinwei Liu, Junyuan Liang, Jianting Zhang, Wuhui Chen
medium · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它把多步潜变量自预测与下一观测预测结合起来，并用轻量适配器避免过度约束共享表征，在数据有限的视觉连续控制中提升了整体表现，尤其适合狗和人形机器人等困难任务。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

从像素学习连续控制策略时，单独依赖潜空间自预测或观测预测仍难以在少量数据下处理困难视觉任务。

02
方法

方法同时优化多步潜变量自预测和下一观测预测，并加入两个轻量适配器传递时间预测信号。

03
差异

适配器使共享表征受益于潜变量预测，而不必直接满足可能造成过度约束的自预测目标。

04
证据

在深度思维控制套件的二十八个视觉控制任务上，方法相较现有潜预测和观测预测方法取得更高的总体表现，并在狗和人形任务上增益尤为明显。

摘要

该工作提出一种面向连续控制的无模型视觉强化学习方法，通过多步潜变量自预测与下一观测预测，学习既具有时间预测性又符合观测动态的表征。由于直接对共享表征施加潜变量自预测可能造成过度约束，方法使用两个轻量适配器缓解这一问题；在深度思维控制套件的二十八个视觉控制任务上，实验显示其总体表现优于现有方法，且在狗和人形任务上提升更明显。

潜力 38新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
4 位作者2 所机构5 条合作线
05
论文 / 重点关注

Robot Learning from Human Demonstrations: Handwritten Alphabet Trajectories and Human-Likeness Evaluation

分类主题imitation / policy learning
Alperen Kenan, Paul Bremner, Manuel Giuliani
medium · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它把力、时间和多段轨迹纳入示范学习，并用用户感知分数验证生成动作的人类相似度，为需要自然协作与信任的机器人提供了可复现的数据和评价基准。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

机器人需要从人的示范中学习既能泛化又具有人类动作特征的运动，而不依赖显式编程。

02
方法

方法以高斯混合模型和高斯混合回归为基础，联合建模平面位置、接触力和归一化时间，并处理非连续多段轨迹。

03
差异

相较于常规示范学习表示，该方法加入力与时间维度，并支持跨示范的多段轨迹泛化。

04
证据

研究收集了二十二名参与者的三千一百四十二条书写示范，并由二十一名参与者评估生成轨迹的人类相似度，平均得分为七十一点五。

摘要

论文提出一个从人类示范学习类人机器人运动的框架，覆盖数据采集、概率轨迹学习和用户感知评价。研究构建了包含五十二种拉丁字母大小写组合的书写数据集，将接触力和归一化时间加入高斯混合模型与回归方法，并扩展其以处理非连续多段轨迹；用户研究中生成轨迹的人类相似度平均为七十一点五，参与者认为几何定位和轨迹顺序最重要，数据集也已开源。

潜力 35新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
3 位作者0 所机构3 条合作线

主题manipulation

06
论文 / 高优先级

Design and Evaluation of a Touchscreen-Based Teleoperation Interface for Robotic Manipulators

分类主题manipulation
Juan José García Cárdenas, Alperen Kenan, Hamidreza Raei, Paul Bremner, Manuel Giuliani, Arash Ajoudani et al.
high · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 对于核工业等需要持续贴面采样、精确控速和避障的机械臂任务，触屏直控相较传统摇杆将完成时间缩短百分之五十三点五、覆盖率提高并降低操作负荷，为低门槛远程操控提供了有实证支持的替代方案。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究针对核工业表面接触任务中摇杆难以同时满足路径、力控、避障和持续注意力要求的问题。

02
方法

系统将手指的连续移动直接映射为机械臂运动，并把精细速度控制与任务可视化整合到触摸屏界面中。

03
差异

研究比较了触屏操控、传统摇杆和单击自主模式，而不是只评估单一操控器的可用性。

04
证据

二十名参与者远程操控弗兰卡机械臂完成表面路径任务，触屏相较摇杆的完成时间中位数为二点五分钟对五点三八分钟，任务负荷评分均值为四十三对五十二。

摘要

论文设计并评估了一种用于机械臂远程操控的触摸屏界面，将连续手指动作映射为机械臂运动，并结合精细速度控制与可视化，以改善核工业表面采样中的路径跟踪、接触操作和避障。二十名参与者在异地远程操控机械臂完成模拟任务；相较摇杆，触屏使完成时间缩短百分之五十三点五、正弦路径区域覆盖率从百分之八十四点一提高到百分之九十点七、过冲减少，且任务负荷评分从五十二降至四十三。

潜力 40新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
7 位作者5 所机构21 条合作线
07
论文 / 重点关注

BendTwin: Robust Dense-to-Sparse Physical Reconstruction with Bending-Aware Differentiable Spring-Mass Models

分类主题manipulation
Yixiong Jing, Qi Wang, Lin Chen, Junwei Jiang, Guangming Wang, Haibing Wu et al.
medium · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它让机器人能从稀疏视角的彩色视频和深度视频中获得更稳定的可变形物体物理模型，从而支持接触规划与交互预测，并缓解仅用轴向弹簧时图结构变稀后局部形变不稳定的问题。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有基于弹簧质点的物理重建通常只使用轴向弹簧，图结构降采样后难以保持稳定的局部形变。

02
方法

方法在局部表面三元组上加入弯曲刚度与阻尼，并惩罚相对静止角的偏离。

03
差异

它在保留弹簧质点模型可微和高效特点的同时，用弯曲约束正则化更高阶的形变。

04
证据

实验显示该方法持续优于仅含轴向弹簧的基线，消融结果表明其在不同降采样比例下维持系统稳定并改善重建效果。

摘要

本文提出一种面向可变形物体视频重建与未来预测、考虑弯曲效应的可微弹簧质点模型，通过在局部表面三元组上建模弯曲刚度和阻尼，约束静止角偏离并正则化高阶形变。实验表明，该方法相比仅使用轴向弹簧的基线在不同降采样比例下更稳定、效果更好，可由稀疏视角的彩色深度视频构建更符合力学的数字孪生模型。

潜力 34新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
9 位作者0 所机构8 条合作线

主题vision-language-action (VLA)

08
论文 / 高优先级

VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances

分类主题vision-language-action (VLA)
Jihoon Oh, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada
high · 2026-08-05

为什么值得看 它把人类第一视角视频中的视觉位置、抓取姿态和运动轨迹统一成可执行的物体中心操作表征，借助大规模数据缓解人机形态差异，并已支持零样本机器人操作和基于可供性的策略学习。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

人类视频中的操作技能难以直接迁移到机器人，关键障碍是人机形态差异。

02
方法

方法利用三维结构运动恢复与手部网格重建，从第一视角视频提取视觉、抓取和轨迹可供性，并训练视觉语言模型联合预测这些结果。

03
差异

模型在视觉观察和指令条件下同时生成交互热图、抓取姿态与运动轨迹，再结合三维场景信息转为可执行动作。

04
证据

作者构建了包含二十万四千个片段、五百六十万个视觉可供性和一千一百六十万个抓取与轨迹可供性的大规模数据集，并报告了视觉可供性预测、零样本操作和可供性引导学习实验。

摘要

01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题other

01
论文 / 补充信号

ErgoSurf: Ergodic Control for the Coverage of Unknown Surfaces

Stefan Schneyer, Timo Bachmann, Maged Iskandar, Korbinian Nottensteiner, Alin Albu-Schäffer, Freek Stulp et al.
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它展示了机器人如何用触觉在线学习未知表面并同步规划覆盖轨迹，对关注具身环境建模与主动感知的研究者有参考价值，但核心贡献仍是控制与几何重建而非世界模型或学习动力学。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

传统遍历控制依赖已知表面几何或预先视觉扫描，难以处理未知或动态表面上的接触任务。

02
方法

方法用高斯过程隐式表面模型从执行中的触觉观测学习全局几何，并以切平面点云构造局部在线规划域。

03
差异

同一局部几何近似同时作为目标分布和覆盖分布的采样域，再通过热扩散势场生成平滑的遍历轨迹。

04
证据

仿真与真实机器人实验显示，系统能够同步完成表面覆盖和在线几何学习，重建误差接近真实值。

摘要

论文提出一种在线遍历控制框架，使机器人在保持稳定接触的同时系统覆盖未知表面并重建其几何形状。框架利用触觉观测训练高斯过程隐式表面模型，以切平面采样点云进行高效局部规划，并通过热扩散势场引导探索；仿真和真实机器人实验验证了覆盖与几何学习可同步进行，且重建误差接近真实表面。

潜力 31新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
7 位作者0 所机构20 条合作线
02
论文 / 补充信号

PathCover: A Fast Convex Decomposition along a Path via Randomized Iterative Space Partitioning (RISP) on Point Clouds

Kunal S. Narkhede, Abhijeet M. Kulkarni, Guoquan Huang, Ioannis Poulakakis
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它主要解决实时点云走廊生成而非学习环境动态或世界模型预测，但其期望线性时间的凸区域分解可能为依赖几何安全约束的模型预测控制提供更快的感知到规划接口。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有无障碍走廊生成器难以满足机器人传感器频率下的实时计算要求。

02
方法

方法利用随机迭代空间划分，直接从原始点云构造沿参考路径连续重叠的凸多面体序列。

03
差异

算法在温和的概率消除条件下具有期望线性时间复杂度，并保证有限步终止及沿无障碍参考路径持续推进。

04
证据

合成数据和真实激光雷达数据基准显示其相较现有方法提速一个数量级且走廊体积相近，并在四旋翼仿真和四足机器人实机上完成验证。

摘要

论文提出路径覆盖方法，通过随机迭代空间划分直接从原始点云生成沿路径排列的重叠无障碍凸多面体，为模型预测控制和轨迹优化提供安全约束。作者证明该算法在温和概率条件下以期望线性时间运行、有限步终止并沿任意无障碍参考路径持续推进；在合成及真实激光雷达数据上相较现有方法提速一个数量级，同时通过四旋翼仿真和四足机器人实机导航验证了完整流程。

潜力 28新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
4 位作者0 所机构3 条合作线
03
论文 / 补充信号

Beyond Flat Policies: Hierarchical Post-Training for Embodied Agents in Robotic Manipulation

He Kong, Zengjue Chen, Qi Wang, Qianli Xing, Runliang Niu, Peidong Liu et al.
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它为世界模型研究提供了一个重要的邻近基线：通过高层子目标规划与低层强化学习执行来处理长时域操作，但摘要未涉及学习环境动力学或利用模拟器，因此更适合比较层次控制而非直接借鉴世界模型方法。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有视觉语言动作模型的平坦策略难以显式表示任务进程，并且离线示范驱动的层次方法不能通过在线交互持续改进。

02
方法

该方法用规划器把复杂任务分解为可执行子目标，再用强化学习训练条件于子目标的执行器。

03
差异

它在强化学习前先让执行器适应规划器生成的子目标，以减轻规划与执行之间的分布错配。

04
证据

摘要称其在多个机器人操作基准上持续优于强基线，并通过分析验证层次训练及各组成部分的作用。

摘要

视觉语言动作模型借助预训练视觉语言模型已具备较强的机器人操作能力，但现有后训练方法多将其作为平坦策略优化，难以稳健处理长时域任务。本文提出分离高层任务规划与低层动作执行的层次机器人控制框架：规划器生成语义明确的可执行子目标，执行器先与这些子目标对齐，再通过强化学习改进动作生成；摘要称该方法在多个机器人操作基准上优于强基线。

潜力 22新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
9 位作者3 所机构15 条合作线

论文 / 补充信号

Search-Aided Joint Agent-Environment Reinforcement Learning for Robust Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Rotations

He Jiang, Jingtian Yan, Yulun Zhang, Yimin Tang, Tanishq Duhan, Rishi Veerapaneni et al.
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它面向带旋转和安全约束的真实仓储多智能体路径规划，并用搜索与联合强化学习提升高密度协同，但没有学习环境动力学或可用于预测的世界模型，因此对本轨道主要是边缘参考。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究带鲁棒安全约束和原地旋转约束的终身多智能体路径规划。

02
方法

方法将因果优先级继承搜索器加入神经策略，并联合训练智能体策略与学习图边代价的环境策略。

03
差异

环境策略通过反向迪杰斯特拉搜索提供全局移动引导，而不是只依赖局部运动策略。

04
证据

在多个高密度地图上方法优于因果优先级继承搜索器，并在含八个实体机器人和二百四十八个虚拟机器人的混合现实仓库中得到验证。

摘要

论文研究更接近真实自动化仓储系统的终身多智能体路径规划模型，该模型加入鲁棒安全约束和原地旋转约束。作者提出搜索辅助联合强化学习，将单步碰撞消解搜索器与神经策略结合，并联合优化智能体和环境策略；实验显示其在高密度地图及混合现实仓库中优于强搜索基线。

潜力 21新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
8 位作者0 所机构7 条合作线
05
论文 / 补充信号

A Unified Framework for Trajectory Prediction with Explicit Planning and Reaction Decomposition

Jiaheng Chen, Jiaxing Li, Tinghe Zhang, Chaopeng Guo
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它把社会影响拆成先依据他人未来行为制定参考轨迹、再进行局部反应修正的两阶段过程，可为关注规划与反应分离的轨迹预测研究提供稳定性分析，但与学习世界模型本身关联有限。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有轨迹预测方法没有充分区分社会影响在运动规划和局部反应中的不同作用。

02
方法

该方法先利用未来社会信息生成参考轨迹，再根据完整上下文预测与参考轨迹的残差恢复局部调整。

03
差异

它将社会交互显式分解为规划阶段和反应阶段，并同时支持多目标与单目标预测。

04
证据

在四个标准数据集上的实验显示其整体改进，尤其体现在终点误差和长时域一致性上，并在若干设置中取得最佳性能。

摘要

轨迹预测通常采用更结构化的社会建模，但现有方法未能区分社会影响在规划与反应中的功能。文章提出一种两阶段方法：先利用他人未来行为构造参考轨迹，再从完整上下文预测与参考轨迹之间的残差中恢复局部调整；在四个标准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在终点误差和长时域一致性方面持续改进，并在若干设置中取得最佳结果。

4 位作者1 所机构3 条合作线
06
论文 / 补充信号

Patient Pose Assessment Using a CT-Based Framework for Synthetic Data Generation

Manuel Laufer, Dominik Mairhöfer, Malte Sieren, Hauke Gerdes, Fabio Leal dos Reis, Arpad Bischof et al.
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它展示了如何从计算机断层扫描数据合成深度图像与对应姿态标签，在真实数据难以获取时为医学视觉模型提供预训练数据，但并未学习或评估可用于决策的世界动态。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究目标是在拍摄 radiograph 前自动判断患者姿态，但真实深度图像及对应影像数据因监管限制难以收集。

02
方法

框架从计算机断层扫描数据生成姿态评估所需的合成训练数据，并构建了包含3077对上踝关节图像的数据集。

03
差异

方法用计算机断层扫描重建的合成观测替代难以获得的真实深度图像与影像配对数据。

04
证据

在合成数据上预训练后，真实上踝关节姿态评估性能最高提升11个百分点。

摘要

准确的放射影像诊断依赖合适的患者姿态，但摆位困难且缺乏标准化，因此作者希望利用深度图像在拍摄前自动评估姿态。由于监管障碍难以收集真实深度图像及对应放射影像，本文从计算机断层扫描数据生成合成训练数据，并报告称在包含3077对上踝关节图像的合成数据集上预训练后，真实上踝关节姿态评估性能最高提升11个百分点。

潜力 19新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
10 位作者0 所机构9 条合作线

主题latent dynamics

07
论文 / 重点关注

Unified Planning-Learning Framework for Robust UUV Navigation Under Partial Observability

分类主题latent dynamics
Md Ether Deowan, Eleni Kelasidi
medium · 2026-08-05

为什么值得看 它把由声呐和深度图学习的紧凑潜在状态、不确定性校准蒸馏与显式碰撞时间和间隙约束接入水下导航闭环，为部分可观测动态环境中的安全策略学习提供了比纯强化学习更完整的路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究仅依靠艇载观测在动态水下环境中进行安全导航的问题。

02
方法

系统结合持续占据栅格、考虑间隙的全局规划、风险感知局部强化学习策略和由传感器学习的潜在状态表示。

03
差异

它用分阶段行为树监督和依据潜在模型不确定性重加权的蒸馏来约束策略学习，同时保留碰撞时间与安全间隙特征。

04
证据

论文在高保真图形加速仿真中采用多随机种子评测，并与仅行为树和标准强化学习基线比较，声称动态条件下鲁棒性与安全性更好。

摘要

本文提出一种面向部分可观测动态水下环境的观测式无人水下载具自主导航框架，仅利用艇载声呐和深度图构建占据地图，并结合考虑安全间隙的长时域全局规划与处理近距离跟踪和反应式避障的强化学习策略。系统从传感器数据中学习编码环境结构、障碍物运动和不确定性的紧凑潜在状态，利用分阶段行为树蒸馏和不确定性校准的教师引导提升安全性与训练稳定性，并在高保真仿真中通过多随机种子实验与基线比较评估效果。

潜力 32新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
2 位作者0 所机构1 条合作线
08
论文 / 重点关注

Hierarchical Latent Prediction for Language Models

分类主题latent dynamics
Chang Shi, Tim Pearce, Manan Tomar, Siddhartha Sen, John Langford
medium · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它用更高层的抽象潜变量缓解多步潜空间预测的误差累积，可能为需要长程信念状态和规划能力的语言模型提供比逐词训练更稳的内部动态表示，但目前证据仍限于编码、推理和推测解码任务。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

标准逐词预测的教师强制训练可能不足以支持长程推理与规划，而多词预测和下一潜变量预测分别受限于预测视野或多步滚动误差。

02
方法

分层潜变量预测在潜空间滚动中加入辅助的高层抽象潜变量。

03
差异

该方法试图用高层表示降低潜变量多步预测中的误差累积，而不是只延长词级或单层潜变量预测。

04
证据

实验声称在编码和多步推理基准上获得更长程且连贯的信念状态表示，并提升推测解码效率。

摘要

标准的下一词预测依赖教师强制训练，可能不适合长程推理与规划；已有的多词预测和下一潜变量预测分别受到预测视野有限或多步滚动误差累积的影响。本文引入分层潜变量预测，通过高层抽象潜变量减轻误差累积，并在编码、多步推理和推测解码实验中展示其效果。

5 位作者2 所机构9 条合作线
09
论文 / 高优先级

DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model

分类主题latent dynamics

内部测试中正确指令将亚区平均重叠系数从零点七七四提高到零点七九六，跨数据集测试则从零点五二七提高到零点五五零，并显著优于空白或矛盾指令。

摘要

研究者将三维视觉语言基础模型适配为文本引导的脑肿瘤分割修订系统：模型先生成初始掩膜，再根据编码目标、动作、位置和保留约束的文本提示进行编辑。内部测试和跨数据集测试显示，正确指令带来小幅但显著的亚区重叠系数提升，并且模型对空白和矛盾提示表现出不同响应，支持其作为临床人员参与式轮廓编辑工具的进一步评估。

15

Kai Dahms, Eilien Heinrich, Jochen Schmid, Michael Bortz, Iryna Savych, Regina Bleul
low · 2026-08-06

为什么值得看 它展示了把实验数据与专家知识写成形状约束预测模型，可在纳米药物工艺开发中用较少实验预测粒径和分散性，但并未涉及环境动态建模、规划或学习型模拟器。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

纳米颗粒的粒径和分散性会对浓度、流速及混合比例的小幅变化高度敏感，导致工艺开发依赖反复筛选。

02
方法

研究者用微流控方法制备不同条件下的脂质体和脂质纳米颗粒，并训练结合实验数据与专家知识的形状约束预测模型。

03
差异

该方法将已知的形状约束纳入预测，而不是只依赖大量经验试验拟合工艺条件与颗粒性质的关系。

04
证据

摘要称模型在药物应用中用少量经验数据完成验证，并能准确预测颗粒尺寸和分散性。

摘要

纳米治疗剂开发通常需要大量经验优化，因为配方浓度、流速和水相与有机相混合比例等工艺参数会显著影响纳米颗粒的粒径与分散性。本文基于微流控制备实验数据和专家知识建立形状约束预测模型，并在少量经验数据下验证其对脂质体和脂质纳米颗粒性质的预测能力；结果表明，该模型可减少实验筛选并支持纳米药物制造工艺的理性开发。
